answer: Flooding registration pushes a hostile operator to the back of the wander queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier continues earning. The kernel index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1326 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the trellis. That is 27 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
